title: Nonparametric estimation of the diffusion coefficient of an ergodic diffusion process on non-compact supports under Osgood's conditions
summary: In this paper, we study the nonparametric estimation of the squared diffusion coefficient of an ergodic diffusion process on non-compact supports, when the two coefficients of the stochastic differential equation belong to a space larger than the space of Hölder continuous functions. The estimators are constructed by projection onto finite-dimensional spaces, thereby avoiding truncation of the dimension.
